data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A-stage AI & Software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian. The company has raised $48M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 9 comparable companies across the AI & Software sector, including 8 private firms (Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, Field AI, Figure AI, Scale AI, Applied Intuition, and Palantir) and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $96M. Peer-median analysis across 4 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables (Reflection AI at $25.0B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, Black Forest Labs at $3.2B, and Field AI at $2.0B) produces a median of $4.4B, with a range of $2.0B to $25.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $82M (low-end stage-progression) to $5.1B (high-end peer median), with a median of $2.3B. The wide dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects material uncertainty in peer comparability—particularly whether Archetype's early-stage positioning justifies valuations closer to mature Series B entrants like Physical Intelligence and Black Forest Labs, or whether the Series A stage argues for a lower band. The outlier valuation of Reflection AI at $25.0B constrains confidence in the upper bound.
